newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Reid taps banks for $122.5 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Reid taps banks for $122.5 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, September 18 (LPC) - Reid Plastics has tapped J.P. Morgan and Co Inc and Banque Paribas for a fully underwritten, $122.5 million bank loan backing Reid's acquisition of Stuart Walker and Plastic Containers, market sources said.
The deal also takes out a $44 million loan put in place by Paribas in March 1995, according to bankers.
The credit is split between a $40 million revolver and a $50 million, amortizing term loan, both of which run six years, a banker said.
There also is a $32.5 million "B" term loan, which has a longer maturity than the amortizing term loan and revolver, the banker added.
Pricing starts at 150 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), with a 50-basis-point commitment fee on undrawn amounts, sources said.
The "B" term loan is priced at 200 basis points over LIBOR, sources added.
